description:
Outcome: Two members competing for one court/slot cannot both reserve it, from README and the owner request to make prevention of double bookings a separate ticket.
Scope: One shared atomic reservation write path built on the database uniqueness constraint; server-derived authenticated ownership; SQLite-compatible transaction/serialization; duplicate/conflict handling and bounded busy/retry outcomes. Provide an internal in-transaction policy hook for member-limit checks before writing. Excludes: seven-day window, two-upcoming cap, cancellation and member-facing pages.
Acceptance: Competing separate-connection requests for one slot persist exactly one booking; rejected conflicts leave no write; another free slot remains reservable.
Behaviour: Clear domain conflicts, bounded contention recovery, no partial writes, duplicate reservations or misleading success. Keep the internal path unexposed until full booking policies are installed; UI cannot bypass them.
Verification: Real database concurrency tests with separate connections, duplicate-constraint handling and contention/retry tests. Do not assume select_for_update provides SQLite row locking. Prerequisites: T-002 and T-003. Assumptions: all later reservation writes share this atomic path.
title: Prevent double bookings
